moa: AAV5 vector-based gene therapy delivering factor VIII

approval_evidence.quote: For Immediate Release: June 29, 2023 ... Today, the U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved Roctavian, an adeno-associated virus vector-based gene therapy for the treatment of adults with severe hemophilia A

search_log: Listed every BioMarin filing (all forms incl. 8-K, 8-K/A) for CIK 0001048477 via data.sec.gov/submissions incl. older 'files' pages (scripts/common.py); earnings 8-Ks selected by item 2.02; exhibits resolved from each filing's index.json (scripts/lib.py).

Product rows pulled by table-row parsing of each earnings Exhibit 99.1; quarter taken from the document's own 'three months ended' header and cross-checked against the next year's prior-year column (scripts/bm.py).
Roctavian is printed as its own line 'ROCTAVIAN Net Product Revenues' from the Q3 2023 release (filed 2023-11-01); earlier releases only give guidance ('ROCTAVIAN Revenues' $100-200M).
Footnote (1) in the 2026Q2 release states that in 2026 the company announced it will no longer market ROCTAVIAN; the line is still printed through 2026Q2 so the series runs to 2026Q2.

launch_evidence.quote: We treated the first commercial patient with ROCTAVIAN in Germany in the third quarter of 2023
